submitted.rationale: Index 12 (Mn0.51Y0.49) had the highest measured photocurrent, 1.4e-7 A. The Mn-rich sample (index 3, Mn0.77) gave 1e-8 A and the Y-rich sample (index 16, Mn0.36) gave -1e-8 A, so the response peaks near the 1:1 Mn:Y composition. XRD showed the same single peak at Q≈2.784 Å⁻¹ at Mn fractions from 0.25 to 0.51, so phase changes don't separate the candidates.

rejected.reason: Measured 1e-8 A, an order of magnitude below index 12
